crime: For several weeks, {WITCH_NAME} and her closest friend meet at the pool table during the first part of evening free time. The friend enjoys practicing with {WITCH_NAME}; {WITCH_NAME} depends on hearing a promise of another game tomorrow before ending each night’s play.

During morning free time, {WITCH_NAME} and the friend play pool; two other girls are nearby. A splinter on one cue cuts {WITCH_NAME}'s palm, and her blood stains the grip. The friend takes {WITCH_NAME} to the medical room and wraps the cut in gauze.

Afterward, the friend says she will spend future evenings reading alone instead of continuing their daily pool game, though they can still talk at meals. {WITCH_NAME} quietly says that the game that evening will be their last. The friend agrees to play once more.

At the start of evening free time, the two girls see {WITCH_NAME} and the friend enter the recreation room, then continue down the hall without watching the door. A short time later, the two girls enter and find the friend dead beside the pool table with two blunt wounds to the head.

The morning’s cue lies beside the friend’s body, with the friend’s blood and hair on its thick end. Half of {WITCH_NAME}'s gauze is clenched in the dead friend’s hand; the matching torn half remains around {WITCH_NAME}'s reopened cut. One continuous smear of the friend’s blood crosses the cue grip and the outer surface of the gauze still on {WITCH_NAME}'s palm. The two edges align when {WITCH_NAME}'s hand and the cue are placed together. Yet {WITCH_NAME}'s morning blood spot and all new blood from the reopened cut are gone from the grip.

The matching gauze shows that the friend tore {WITCH_NAME}'s bandage while resisting, and the wounds, blood, and hair identify the cue as the murder weapon. The continuous smear proves that {WITCH_NAME} held it after the first blow made the friend bleed. Her reopened palm had to leave blood on the same grip, yet neither the old spot nor the new blood remains. Trace Erasure can remove from one nonliving object every bodily trace left by one person she names. During their last game, {WITCH_NAME} struck the friend twice in the head with the thick end, killing her, then named herself and erased her own traces from the cue without disturbing the friend's blood and hair before leaving.
fields.epitaph: Every goodbye came too early, until tomorrow stopped answering.
execution: A heavy guillotine blade hangs above an iron neck rest, with her neck locked beneath it. Several times, the blade drops toward her neck, stops just before touching her, and rises again.
The final drop does not stop. The blade cuts through her neck, severing her head and killing her.

magic.name: Trace Erasure
magic.text: She can erase traces from an object.
